What if you could fall in love, or forge deep connections, in just 45 minutes? Our guests, Kristen Meinzer and Jolenta Greenberg of By The Book podcast, try out 36 questions with their partners to see if they can strengthen their connection.

Summary: In this episode of The Science of Happiness we explore the science behind the famous 36 questions designed to spark romance and deepen connections between people. Guests Kristen Meinzer and Jolenta Greenberg share what happened when they tried the questions with their husbands, revealing how the practice helped them rediscover intimacy, learn new things about each other, and feel closer. Psychologists Arthur and Elaine Aron, who developed the questions, explain why gradually building vulnerability, listening with care, and sharing openly can strengthen relationships of all kinds.
Find a comfortable, quiet space: Set aside about 45 minutes to spend with someone you want to feel closer to. Put away distractions and give each other your full attention.
Start with lighter questions: Begin with questions that are fun, thoughtful, and easy to answer. For example, “If you could have dinner with anyone in the world, who would it be?”
Take turns answering: Work through the questions together, alternating who answers first. Make sure both people have equal opportunities to share and participate.

Gradually go deeper: The questions become more personal as you go. Move from everyday experiences to your hopes, fears, meaningful memories, and relationships. Allow trust and comfort to build naturally.
Listen with curiosity and care: Pay attention to what the other person shares. Show that you hear, understand, and validate their responses rather than jumping in with advice or judgment.

Be open and responsive: Share honestly and allow yourself to be vulnerable, while respecting each other's comfort levels. The goal isn't to get through every question perfectly, but to create a conversation where both people feel seen, heard, and understood.
JOLENTA GREENBERG is a podcaster, comedian, author, and culture critic.
KRISTEN MEINZER is an award-winning podcaster, culture critic, lifestyle journalist, and author.
Arthur Aron is a professor of psychology at the State University of New York at Stony Brook.
Elaine Aron is an American clinical research psychologist and author.
